info.name: Incentive Journey Ride Progress Flow
info.description:
Provider E2E: Daily journey with two RideCompleted milestones (each GTE 1, progress resets) and one Earnings milestone the driver does not finish. The same cohort has a second journey (one RideCompleted GTE 2, 200 coins) via a second cohort-journey mapping and a second driver assign. A separate cohort and journey are auto-applied for AUTO_CATEGORY, the same category set when the driver vehicle is added, with no user mapping (allowIfNoMapping false, so it still applies when the driver has other mappings). Two AUTO cash rides complete journey 1's ride milestones, journey 2's 2-ride target, and the auto-apply ride milestone. Dashboard waive-off marks the earnings milestone WaivedOff for that periodKey, and the first cohort mapping streak-end reward pays 500 coins. Cleanup unassigns both user mappings, disables those cohort-journey mappings, and disables the auto-apply row.

Requires kafka-consumers (DriverCoinsAndJourney / RIDE_EVENTS). Dashboard peer path: .../incentiveJourney/...

See IncentiveJourneyFlow/Rules.md.
